teaser: The fire at a campsite burns low toward midnight, and you are still awake, listening to someone two tents over cry about trouble that is not yours to carry. Life path 9 reaches toward everyone's trouble as a matter of course; ISFP reaches toward whatever can be felt directly, in the body, before it is ever argued into a thought. Put these in one person and compassion arrives through the senses first — a catch in a voice, a tightness in someone's shoulders — before it becomes an idea at all. The pull sits close by: a 9 is built for a wide, general love, and an ISFP loves specific people, in specific rooms, fiercely. This Reading follows what happens when the wide and the particular share one chest.
